result.title: RadAI: Gaze-Intention Fusion Pipeline for Attention-Guided Educational Videos in Chest X-Ray Interpretation
result.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, accepted to 2026 MIT IEEE URTC conference
result.summary: Chest radiograph interpretation errors often arise from failures in visual search: although trainees may correctly identify an abnormality once pointed out, they frequently fail to fixate on the relevant region, while expert search strategies (where radiologists look, in what sequence, and for how long) remain largely implicit. Eye movement modeling examples (EMME), which replay a recorded expert's gaze over the image, have been shown to improve novice detection of findings on chest radiographs, but producing one requires an eye-tracking session on that specific case, so teaching sets are limited to recorded sessions by experts. In this work, RadAI is presented, the first end-to-end framework for transforming predicted radiologist gaze into narrated instructional videos, enabling scalable gaze-guided training without collecting new eye-tracking data. Given only a chest X-ray and its report, RadAI predicts an expert fixation sequence, associates each interval of that sequence with the diagnostic finding it pursues, extracts the corresponding image region, and renders the result as an EMME-style video in which each highlighted finding is narrated with synthesized speech. RadAI is evaluated on 97 cases from the EGD-CXR dataset, assessing whether the highlighted regions correspond to annotated abnormality locations. We position this work as a framework for scalable generation of educational content for residents and medical students in the field of radiology.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RadAI 端到端流程：仅给定胸片与放射报告，先预测专家注视序列，再把序列各时段与所追查的诊断发现对齐、裁剪对应图像区域，合成为带语音解说的 EMME 式教学视频，并在 EGD-CXR 的 97 例上检验高亮区域是否落在标注病灶上。
AI.relevance_reason: 由报告条件生成「看哪里、按何种顺序、看多久」的注视轨迹并切分到具体发现，可能为 VLM 推理中的视觉证据筛选与扫视顺序先验提供线索；但该工作面向教学视频生成，不涉及内部推理状态或答案生成，其预测注视的可靠性值得核查。
